styleIdentity.description: A flat, low-resolution pixel-art construction language: everything is built from axis-aligned rectangles and right triangles snapped to a coarse pixel grid, with no gradients, no outlines and no anti-aliasing. Depth is expressed purely as stacked horizontal parallax bands (far sky, mid wall, near ground) whose elements never bleed across bands. Detail is carried by a handful of small high-contrast marks placed sparsely on large flat fields, so shapes read as silhouettes first and textures second.

camera.projection: orthographic side view with flat layered parallax bands, no vanishing point
camera.perspective: 2D side-scroller; background bands stacked with no depth foreshortening

composition.background: flat dark sky band occupying the top of the frame, carrying only silhouette shapes
composition.midground: a wide horizontal wall band with windows, framed panels and a thin lamp post mounted on its surface
composition.foreground: a horizontal platform band with a darker rail band directly beneath it
composition.density: sparse — large uninterrupted flat fields punctuated by a few small detail marks
composition.characterScale: character roughly one-fifth of frame height, standing on the near ground band
composition.objectScale: props are small blocks and thin strips relative to the wall, never filling a band

lighting.contrast: low-to-moderate; local contrast created only by putting a light small shape on a dark field or vice versa
lighting.mood: quiet end-of-day dusk, dim but readable, warm accents glowing against cool murk

wall.appearance: matte flat plaster/wood panel surface, no specular
wall.texture: none; only vertical seams implied by flat color rectangles

ridge.appearance: solid silhouette shape, darker than sky

sun.appearance: small solid disc of warm light, slightly brighter than surroundings

terrain.appearance: matte concrete/gravel platform and rail bed
terrain.texture: repetition of small dark dashes for rail sleepers

cloth.appearance: flat dark fabric of a coat and cap
cloth.texture: none; shading only as a lighter chest rectangle

metal.appearance: dull painted metal for lamp post, signal head and door panels

signal.appearance: small saturated lens in a dark housing, must stay readable at pixel scale

lampGlow.appearance: tiny warm emissive bulb mark on a thin pole

luggage.appearance: matte leather cases and a rolled travel bundle
luggage.texture: flat with a single darker strap line

character.proportions: short chunky figure, head roughly one-third of body height, blocky torso and stubby legs
character.silhouette: readable in pure black: square cap on a boxy head, wide rectangular coat, two separate leg columns, a rounded bundle bump above the shoulder line
character.faceAbstraction: two dark square eyes and a tiny mouth mark on a flat pale face rectangle, no other features
character.clothing: long dark overcoat over a lighter chest panel, a belt buckle square, small pale gloved hands, cap with a dark band
character.poseLanguage: upright idle stance with both feet planted; movement expresses as the same silhouette with leg columns separated, never limb articulation

environment.terrain: one continuous flat platform strip with a rail bed of repeating dark dashes directly below it
environment.architecture: a single long station wall with large flat rectangular window frames, thin vertical door panels clamped to its surface, and one thin lamp post
environment.props: a bench, stacked luggage cases, a low rain-canopy step, and a signal post with a small colored lens at the far end
environment.textureDensity: very low; each prop is two to four flat rectangles, repeated horizontally

shapeLanguage: axis-aligned rectangles as the default unit
right triangles confined to silhouettes of mountains and window-frame scenery
small dark dashes as the only repeating surface pattern
circles appear only as the sun disc and the lamp bulb
1-2 pixel thick strips for poles, straps, rails and sleepers
every element snaps to a coarse pixel grid
constraints: Build every form from axis-aligned rectangles or right triangles only; no curves except a single sun disc and a lamp bulb.
No gradients, no outlines, no anti-aliasing, no drop shadows: separate shapes by flat color value only.
Keep three strictly horizontal parallax bands (sky / wall / platform-plus-rail); no element may cross a band boundary.
Indicate walkable height changes only by stacking extra rectangles on the platform strip; the base platform stays flat and level.
Keep the character silhouette identifiable by cap, coat and a shoulder bundle so it reads against both dark sky and dark wall.
Every hazard, pickup and goal must be distinguishable by shape and color alone at native pixel resolution, with no text or icons.
Lamp bulb, sun disc and signal lens are the only emissive-looking marks; keep them the highest-chroma small shapes in any frame.
Reuse the same wall and ground modules horizontally without variation; the sky band is the only band allowed unique, non-repeating content.
A HUD panel anchored in the bottom-left corner holds exactly three identity slots; keep the play field clear of it.
Signal states are conveyed by swapping the lens color between the reserved alert and the reserved go color, never by size or position change.

identity: sparse detail marks on large flat fields

composition.horizon: upper third sky / middle wall / lower ground
